title: gpt 5.6 too dangerous to release #ai #openai #chatgpt
description:
The White House is pressuring OpenAI to slow down ChatGPT releases over security concerns.

We examine why federal officials are intervening in AI development and what this means for future model launches. This breakdown covers the specific safeguards the government is demanding before new tools reach the public.

Subscribe for more updates on AI policy and tech regulation.
